title: Applying an exclusive-or translation twice
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $z,c\in\{0,1\}^n$. Translating $z$ coordinatewise by exclusive-or with $c$ twice returns $z$: $(z\oplus c)\oplus c=z$.
replaced: For $n\ge0$ and $z,c\in\{0,1\}^n$, let $\oplus$ denote coordinatewise addition modulo two. Then $(z\oplus c)\oplus c=z$.
